name: CreativeMornings: Raising the Bar with Sahana Gopal
description: Sahana Gopal is the founder and CEO of UNRACK, a Bangalore-based precision strength equipment manufacturer, and a Strength & Conditioning Coach who supported British Diving through the Tokyo and Paris Olympic cycles, including Team GB women's diving's historic medal-winning campaigns. She holds a PhD in Biomedical Science & Engineering from Imperial College London, with a career spanning femtech product development and female athlete physiology.
